posts.title: Heroes of Might and Magic 3 online lobby adventures
posts.description: I’ve played Heroes of Might and Magic 3 with the HD and HOTA mods for years and always wondered how its online lobby actually works - how accounts, rooms, and chat go over the wire. So I loaded HD_HOTA.dll (the DLL implementing the whole lobby client) into IDA and dug in. A good chunk of the analysis was done with the help of AI. posts.description: I open-sourced a set of community CTF challenges I created for CTFlearn . posts.title: Fuzzing libfyaml
posts.description: I spent some time fuzzing libfyaml , a feature-rich YAML parser/emitter written in C. The first campaign ended with 68 reported bugs, all of which were fixed by the maintainer. I kept going after that, and the approach changed a lot - see the update at the end of the article. Target libfyaml is a YAML library that supports YAML 1.2.
